business_summary: Batliboi Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades machine tools and textile engineering machines in India and internationally. The company is involved in machine tools, air engineering, textile machinery, environmental engineering, wind energy, motors, international marketing, and logistics business. It also engages in the design, manufacture, sale, and service of gantry drilling and milling machines for energy, heat transfer, steel service, industrial machinery manufacturers, and job shop manufacturing sectors. In addition, the company is involved in the business of water effluent treatment plants and zero liquid discharge for industries. Batliboi Limited was founded in 1892 and is based in Mumbai, India.
